availableCommands.name: vibe:create-plugin
availableCommands.description: Create a Vibe plugin package — the Agent Plugins 1.0 format with optional Vibe extensions for skills, MCP servers, hooks, knowledge, agents, libraries, and connectors. Use when the user wants to create, scaffold, or author a plugin for Mistral Vibe.

availableCommands.name: vibe:skill-creator
availableCommands.description: Load this skill before creating, updating, or deleting a Vibe skill, or whenever you plan to add or modify SKILL.md files under a skills directory. It explains Vibe's SKILL.md frontmatter, discovery order, support files, and the permission flow.

availableCommands.name: vibe:worktree
availableCommands.description: Create, reuse, and clean up git worktrees under $VIBE_HOME/worktrees. Use when the user wants to work in an isolated git worktree, create a worktree for a task, or list/remove existing worktrees.
